# Telling the time and the days of the week

## Introduction

To make a plan with someone you need two things: when, and on which day. Spanish tells the time with "ser" and the feminine article, because "la hora" is feminine, and puts "el" before a day where English puts "on" ([SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)).

## Lesson overview

- Asking and telling the time with "es la" and "son las".
- Saying at what time something happens with "a las".
- The days of the week and the article "el".

## Before you start

Answer these from what you already know. Check them in the sidecar after the assignment.

1. Why might one o'clock take "es" when every other hour takes "son"?
2. How would you guess "on Monday" is said?

## Words

| Word | Reading | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| la hora | - | the time, the hour | ¿Qué hora es? |
| el lunes | - | Monday, on Monday | El lunes trabajo. |
| el martes | - | Tuesday | _El martes tengo clase._ |
| el miércoles | - | Wednesday | _Nos vemos el miércoles._ |
| el jueves | - | Thursday | _El jueves salgo temprano._ |
| el viernes | - | Friday | El viernes vamos al cine. |
| el sábado | - | Saturday | El sábado descanso. |
| el domingo | - | Sunday | _El domingo comemos con mi familia._ |
| y media | - | half past | Son las tres y media. |
| menos cuarto | - | quarter to | Son las ocho menos cuarto. |

Source: [SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)

## Assignment

1. **[SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)**
   Why: the reference for "es la", "son las" and "a las".
   How: read the guide once, then cover the examples and say them.
   Do: write the time on five clocks around you, in words.
2. **[Easy Spanish on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@EasySpanish)**
   Why: street interviews where people say when they do things.
   How: pick an episode about routines, watch with Spanish subtitles, then again without.
   Do: note every time and day you hear, and shadow three of those sentences.
3. **[Coffee Break Spanish](https://coffeebreaklanguages.com/spanish/)**
   Why: a slow dialogue that makes a plan for the week.
   How: play the episode on making plans and pause after each line.
   Do: answer the host's questions before the student does.
